title: Measuring Temperature
summary: Clinical, laboratory and digital thermometers, reading scales carefully, and the Celsius, Fahrenheit and kelvin scales.

ib.note: Absolute zero is explored in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Temperature and its Measurement

objectives: I can choose the right thermometer for a job and explain why.
I can read a thermometer scale accurately, with my eye level with the liquid.
I can convert temperatures between °C, °F and K.
misconceptions: A clinical thermometer can measure any temperature.
Touch is a reliable way to measure temperature.
0 °C means there is no heat at all.
